The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed because cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical risk statistics. This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, incorrect function syntax, or missing references. While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived calculations in the 'Task' sheet failed the assert_matrix verifier with multiple mismatches.
